text: Who works on what: attribute work on ideas to git accounts
description: Felix 2026-10-16: with several people on one graph, we need a "who is working on something" system: not a status, rather an owner. But any git user could change an owner field. Each person should use Aimparency through their own git account, so changes stay accountable; a shared "common git account mode" is probably not a good idea.

status.comment: Felix 2026-10-16: an explicit field that anyone may change is fine. Git history shows who set whom, so someone who enters another person without authority can still be held to account. Shape: an optional list of git identities on the idea (who is working on it), editable in the UI and MCP. Each person uses their own git account; no shared account mode.
